new_categories.label: dry_cargo_contamination_condition_assurance_readiness
new_categories.memory: Dry-cargo contamination-condition assurance is a delivered condition-state distinct from the availability of cleaning equipment or the mere existence of physical separation materials.

new_categories.label: cargo_hold_scope_coverage_confidence
new_categories.memory: Contamination-condition assurance can be bounded to a cargo parcel, hold, hold region or operation stage without retaining exact cargo, contaminant or location details.

new_categories.label: non_specific_contamination_condition_confidence
new_categories.memory: A non-specific confidence that cargo/hold condition is free from a material contamination concern can be represented without naming contaminants, concentrations or acceptance limits.

new_categories.label: foreign_material_condition_confidence
new_categories.memory: Foreign-material concern can be represented as a distinct condition dimension without retaining exact material identity, amount or cause.

new_categories.label: residue_condition_confidence
new_categories.memory: Residue condition from a prior or adjacent cargo/operation can be represented separately from general hold-cleaning service readiness.

new_categories.label: cross_contamination_boundary_confidence
new_categories.memory: Confidence in preventing or detecting cross-contamination across bounded cargo/hold scopes is distinct from physical segregation hardware readiness and from cargo identity traceability.

new_categories.label: observation_sampling_path_availability
new_categories.memory: Availability of an observation or sampling path can be represented separately from the resulting contamination-condition judgment.

new_categories.label: sampling_coverage_representativeness_confidence
new_categories.memory: Confidence that observations or samples represent the intended cargo/hold scope is distinct from path availability and from the final condition assessment.

new_categories.label: condition_verification_validity_confidence
new_categories.memory: Verification validity can degrade independently from observation/sampling availability without retaining exact test method, calibration, threshold or acceptance criterion.

new_categories.label: independent_contamination_crosscheck_confidence
new_categories.memory: Independent or alternate condition cross-check confidence can be represented separately from the primary observation/sampling path without retaining laboratory or claims procedure.

new_categories.label: contamination_assurance_degradation_lifecycle
new_categories.memory: Contamination-condition assurance can move through available, degraded, restricted, isolated, under-restoration and restored states with separate timestamps.

new_categories.label: scoped_contamination_restriction_downstream_not_root_cause
new_categories.memory: Restrictions can attach to scope, observation/sampling, representativeness, condition or verification state, while rejection, claims, segregation concern, rework or delay do not prove the root cause.

new_categories.label: multi_timestamp_contamination_assurance_restoration
new_categories.memory: Observation/sampling recovery, representative coverage, condition re-verification, cross-check recovery, receiver confidence and restriction release can occur at different times.

useful_refinements.label: contamination_condition_vs_cleaning_service
useful_refinements.memory: P117 cleaning/washdown service availability does not establish the actual contamination, foreign-material or residue condition of the cargo/hold scope.

useful_refinements.label: cross_contamination_vs_physical_separation
useful_refinements.memory: P115 physical dunnage/lining/separation readiness may support segregation but does not by itself establish contamination-condition assurance or cross-contamination absence.

useful_refinements.label: contamination_vs_moisture_condition
useful_refinements.memory: P120 cargo moisture/wetness condition is one specific cargo-condition dimension and should not be treated as equivalent to broader contamination or foreign-material assurance.

useful_refinements.label: condition_assurance_vs_identity_traceability
useful_refinements.memory: P125 identity/lot traceability can remain intact even when cargo condition is contaminated, and contamination concern does not by itself prove an identity mapping failure.

duplicates.label: generic_observation_sampling_representativeness_validity_pattern
duplicates.memory: Generic observation/sampling availability, representativeness, validity and cross-check mechanics repeat prior measurement/condition families.

duplicates.label: generic_scoped_restriction_downstream_restoration
duplicates.memory: Generic restriction/isolation, downstream-effect separation and multi-stage restoration are already campaign-wide.

stop_reason: The bounded dry-cargo contamination/foreign-material/residue/cross-contamination condition-assurance questions are answered; further recall trends toward exact contaminants, concentrations, tolerances, sampling/test methods, cleaning/rejection procedures, providers or incidents that are deferred to Evidence.
epistemic_boundary: Memory-only defensive dry-cargo contamination/foreign-material/residue/cross-contamination condition-assurance orientation and source-discovery output; not sampling, testing, cleaning, segregation, rejection, disposal, claims or cargo-quality procedure guidance and not proof of any exact contaminant, value, tolerance, method, procedure, provider, incident or current-readiness fact.
